text:
noah: Hi -- accepted the org invite but when I go to a private repo I get 404 and the org page shows "Pending outside collaborator" next to my name. 2FA is on. I thought I was a member?

[devex-bot]: GitHub Invite Event 1976543321: invitation accepted for noah (noah@personalmail.com). Note: some repos require SAML SSO authorization and org membership provisioning.

sana: welcome! quick checklist: 1) make sure the email on the invite matches the email on your GH account (Settings -> Emails). 2) if you were added as an "Outside collaborator" you'll only have repo-level access, not org teams. 3) if your account shows "Pending outside collaborator" it's usually because SAML SSO wasn't authorized.

noah: how do i authorize SAML SSO? i don't see an "Authorize" button on the org page, only a prompt to sign in with my company SSO which redirects to our idp and then back.

ops-bot: SSO policy: org requires SAML SSO for private repos. To authorize, go to https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso and click "Authorize". If you're redirected, complete sign-in and then return to the org page.

lena: If that still shows outside-collab after authorize, post your handle and i'll convert you to a full org member (we need your work email in the org to map teams). Also check your account has the work email verified.

noah: handle is noahcodes. my GH profile had only my personal email. i added and verified my work email, authorized SSO, refreshed and now it shows me as Member but still can't open infra-private, 403.

sana: hmm, sounds like you were auto-invited as an outside collaborator earlier, and the onboarding automation didn't reconcile after you added the work email. i'll trigger a re-provision.

[devex-bot]: Onboarding automation: reconcile job queued for noahcodes (job id: 90312).

lena: manually changing your relationship now 1976543330: changed noahcodes from Outside collaborator to Member and added to team "platform-eng". Give permissions ~2-3 minutes.

noah: refreshed and can access infra-private repo. cloning now. thanks! :party_parrot:

sana: noted — i'll add a step to the new-hire checklist to reconcile outside-collab invites when work email is later added. saves a step for future hires.

noah: one last Q: should i use SSH or HTTPS while onboarding?

lena: either works. we recommend SSH for day-to-day dev. if you use HTTPS enable credential manager or `gh auth login` so token auth is cached.

noah: got it, thanks everyone :)
